data.raw_text:
[5:50PM] #Dopemu #TrafficUpdate 

 Currently traffic is  flowing smoothly from Cement inwards Dopemu, continuing under the bridge towards Iyana Ipaja. Similarly, the Goye intersection leading towards Alaguntan on Alimosho Road, including Akiwowo and Cash Street, which connects Moshalashi in both directions, is experiencing good traffic conditions.

 The Dopemu bridge towards Akowonjo roundabout, covering areas such as Sha Sha, Cele, Shobo, Kwara, Jimoh, Vulcanizer, Micom, Alaroro, Bakery, and Ogunlana junction, leading to Egbeda, is also reporting smooth vehicular movement. 

For the return journey from Egbeda connecting to the Lagos-Abeokuta Expressway, traffic is moving well through Swipha, Agbotikuyo, Oniwaya, and the associated adjoining roads, with no current reports of impediments. Our personnel are presently on  ground to manage traffic flow effectively.

#FollowLASTMA

data.raw_text:
[6:27PM] #Idumota #TrafficUpdate 

Uninterrupted traffic flow in and out of Idumota proper, with vehicles moving smoothly.
Good traffic conditions from Tinubu Square to Nnamdi Azikiwe Street, extending down to Tom Jones Intersection.
Smooth movement around Oyebanji Roundabout, connecting to Adeniji Adele Road through Oba's Palace and Police Post.
Good traffic flow on the ascending route of Carter Bridge, inward-bound to Ijora Olopa and Oyingbo, as well as connections to Eko Bridge.

#FollowLASTMA
